name: Acrom
classification_notes: A geometric sans with minimal stroke contrast, described by the foundry as leaning humanist rather than purely mechanical.
summary: A geometric sans with minimal stroke contrast that reads as more natural than mechanical.
description: Acrom keeps its construction geometric but softens it with humanist detailing, aiming for legibility across text and display sizes without tipping into the coldness some geometric sans faces have. Manually edited kerning and alternate characters round it out.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Acrom as a geometric sans serif with a minimal stroke contrast, not merely mechanical but also recognisable as a natural typeface with subtle geometric aesthetics.

name: Aesthet
classification_notes: A sans built from hand-drawn ink and brush sketches later refined digitally, giving it exaggerated details that soften at smaller sizes rather than a drafted, mechanical skeleton.
summary: A handmade sans that evolved from ink and brush sketches into a warmer, community-minded alternative to drafted geometrics.
description: Aesthet keeps traces of its hand-drawn origins in its exaggerated headline details, which settle down at smaller sizes to protect text legibility. The foundry frames it as a nod to simple, nature-minded living rather than corporate neutrality.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Aesthet as a reflection embracing a simple, community and nature-inspired lifestyle, showing the evolutionary transition between the handmade and a conventional typeface.

name: Aesthet Nova
classification_notes: A 1970s-inflected display face with rounded serifs, ball terminals and soft corners, redeveloped from the original 2015 Aesthet release into its own display-serif direction.
summary: A rounded, ball-terminalled display serif with a big 1970s personality, reworked from the earlier Aesthet release.
description: Aesthet Nova takes soft corners, rounded serifs and ball terminals into a five-weight display family with a static and variable release, extending its language support to Greek and Cyrillic alongside Latin.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type call Aesthet Nova a smooth talker with a larger-than-life personality, drawing on 1970s aesthetics while keeping a back-to-nature sensibility.

name: Apoka
classification_notes: A moderate-contrast sans with rounded terminals, positioned by the foundry for branding, signage and interface work rather than as a display novelty.
summary: A rounded, moderate-contrast sans built for branding, signage and interface work across six weights.
description: Apoka favours understated simplicity over display flourish, with rounded terminals and careful detailing that suit packaging, UI and identity projects. Character alternates and localised OpenType shapes extend its practical range.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Apoka as a sans-serif type family of six weights, featuring rounded terminals and a moderate contrast with an emphasis on understated simplicity and attention to detail.

name: Baufra
classification_notes: A humanist sans modelled on early twentieth-century sans-serif design, combining geometric construction with an earthier, less mechanical finish.
summary: A humanist sans built on early twentieth-century models, softened with an earthy, less mechanical finish.
description: Baufra takes its cues from early twentieth-century sans-serif design, pairing geometric bones with a naturalism the foundry calls earthy. Broad language support and manually edited kerning make it usable for both display and text.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Baufra as a humanist sans-serif typeface based on the sans-serif typefaces of the early twentieth century, combining geometric design with an earthy naturalism.

name: Boita
classification_notes: An elegant display serif with a generous x-height, high contrast and condensed proportions, closer to a fashion display face than a text serif.
summary: An elegant, condensed display serif with a generous x-height and confident, high-contrast curves.
description: Boita packs a tall x-height and sharp serifs into naturally condensed proportions, giving it impact in space-constrained headlines while keeping the smooth, confident texture of a well-set display serif.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Boita as an elegant display serif type family with a generous x-height, high contrast, confident curves and sharp serifs, smooth as velvet.

name: Calder
classification_notes: A two-voice display collection pairing a semi-connected script with a set of subtle sans variants, grouped together under one outdoors-inspired concept rather than a single letterform structure.
summary: A display collection built around the outdoors, pairing a playful connected script with a family of subtle sans variants and shadow effects.
description: Calder gathers ten related styles under one concept: a semi-connected script alongside authentic, understated sans cuts, several with shadow, grit or outline treatments layered on top. It grew out of the foundry's own interest in adventure and the outdoors.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Calder as a display typeface collection with two distinctive voices, a playful semi-connected script and a selection of subtle yet authentic sans serifs, inspired by the pursuit of the outdoors.

name: Erbaum
classification_notes: A square-boned display sans with an extended x-height and rational detailing, built for clarity of communication over character.
summary: A square, function-driven display sans with an extended x-height for straightforward, no-nonsense communication.
description: Erbaum favours structure over decoration, with a squared skeleton and sharp details built for clarity rather than character. Seven static weights are joined by a variable release for finer control.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Erbaum as a display square sans serif type family that is uncompromisingly function-driven, offering a clear and effective medium for communication.

name: Finlek
classification_notes: A handmade face with subtle script characteristics drawing on Memphis design and Industrial post-punk graphics, built for attitude rather than neutrality.
summary: A rebellious, handmade display face with script leanings, pulling from Memphis design and post-punk graphics.
description: Finlek is built to unsettle rational design conventions rather than serve them, mixing Memphis-era Italian design with British industrial post-punk grit into a single characterful, hand-touched face.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Finlek as a handmade typeface with subtle script characteristics, a mischievous daredevil with style and free spirit, a misfit with an attitude.

name: Hapna
classification_notes: A geometric slab serif with minimal stroke contrast, positioned as an alternative to more novelty-driven slab designs and inspired by early 1950s baseball graphics.
summary: A geometric slab serif inspired by early 1950s baseball culture, offered as a calmer alternative to louder slab designs.
description: Hapna keeps its slab serifs even and its stroke contrast minimal, drawing on the graphic language of early 1950s baseball rather than the heavier novelty slabs common elsewhere. Six weights cover text and display use.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Hapna as a geometric slab serif designed as an alternative to other slab-style fonts on the market, inspired by baseball culture and the graphic language of the early 1950s.

name: Hefring Slab
classification_notes: A geometric slab serif family built on simple geometry with minimal stroke contrast and a uniform slab weight, offered across four widths and a variable release.
summary: A geometric slab serif family spanning Compact to Wide widths, inspired by Margaret Calvert's clear, functional lettering.
description: Hefring Slab builds a uniform, minimal-contrast slab serif across five weights and four widths from Compact through Wide, plus a variable release, keeping a clear, functional character throughout.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Hefring Slab as a geometric slab serif type family based on simple geometry, robust, clear and functional, inspired by the work of Margaret Vivienne Calvert.

name: Hegval Display
classification_notes: A display sans drawing on Gridnik and Helvetica, mixing geometric and neo-grotesque construction with a mildly eccentric character rather than settling into either camp cleanly.
summary: A mildly eccentric display sans drawing on Gridnik and Helvetica, with a full condensed companion.
description: Hegval Display sits between geometric and neo-grotesque construction, with minimal stroke contrast and a slightly unconventional character across five weights, matched by a full Condensed width.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type call Hegval Display mildly eccentric, featuring minimal stroke contrast, geometric design elements and selective emojis, with Gridnik and Helvetica as reference points.

name: Kizo
classification_notes: A condensed geometric sans with modernist, architectural leanings and ink traps for clarity at small sizes, built for display rather than long text.
summary: A condensed geometric sans drawing on urban modernist architecture, with ink traps built in for clarity.
description: Kizo is functional, rational and utilitarian by design, taking its narrow proportions and clean geometry from urban modernist architecture. Ink traps and alternate characters keep detail intact at display sizes.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Kizo as inspired by urban modernist architecture, functional, rational, utilitarian and subtle in its nature.

name: Kotik
classification_notes: A handmade sans pitched as a warmer, more characterful alternative to Helvetica-style neutrality, built for both text and display use.
summary: A handmade sans built for people who like Helvetica's clean appeal but want a little more charm.
description: Kotik keeps a bold, authentic personality while staying modern enough for everyday branding and social use, positioned as a friendlier alternative to the neutral grotesques it's compared against.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Kotik as a handmade sans with a bold personality, created for both text and display, thriving in social media, branding and beyond.

name: Manofa
classification_notes: A calligraphic sans inspired by Warren Chappell's Lydian, built around experiments with the letter O, offered in regular and condensed widths.
summary: A sculptural, calligraphic sans that traces its roots to Warren Chappell's Lydian.
description: Manofa grew out of experiments with the shape of the letter O, landing on a contemporary, sharp and sculptural display sans with matching italics across regular and condensed widths.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Manofa as a calligraphic sans-serif typeface inspired by Warren Chappell's Lydian, originating from experiments with the shape and form of the letter O.

name: Merel
classification_notes: A geometric sans softened with humanist qualities, keeping a reduced x-height and mild stroke contrast alongside vertically sheared terminals.
summary: A geometric sans with a soft, gentle touch, keeping a reduced x-height and mild contrast rather than strict mechanics.
description: Merel stays rational and function-driven at its core but keeps a soft, gentle character through vertically sheared terminals and mild stroke contrast, with a full italic range and variable release.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Merel as a modern geometric typeface with humanist attributes, rational and function-driven in nature yet with a soft and gentle touch.

name: Neubaufra
classification_notes: A Bauhaus-influenced geometric modernist sans, restored and refined for legibility in text and web use while keeping its early twentieth-century character.
summary: A Bauhaus-influenced geometric modernist sans, restored from an early twentieth-century design for contemporary text and web use.
description: Neubaufra keeps its prime modernist characteristics intact while improving legibility for text and screen use, across eight weights with matching italics.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Neubaufra as a geometric modernist type family with Bauhaus influence, a restoration of the original work retaining its prime modernist characteristics with improved legibility.

name: Neusa
classification_notes: A condensed geometric sans inspired by mid-century space-exploration imagery, working as both a text and display face.
summary: A condensed geometric sans inspired by Life magazine's coverage of the 1969 Apollo missions.
description: Neusa takes its narrow, geometric structure from mid-century space-age imagery, working across eight weights as both a text and display face. A wider, updated Neusa Neu family later expanded on the same starting point.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Neusa as a condensed geometric sans serif typeface inspired by the early space explorations, including the iconic Life magazine coverage of the 1969 Apollo program.

name: Neusa Neu
classification_notes: A refined, wider-ranging update of Neusa, spanning Compact to Extra Wide widths with a full italic range for both text and display use.
summary: A refined update of Neusa, expanded across five widths from Compact to Extra Wide with a complete italic range.
description: Neusa Neu takes the original 2012 Neusa concept and broadens it into a full geometric sans system, spanning five widths and seven weights with italics for both text and display work.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Neusa Neu as a refined geometric sans serif type family, an enhanced iteration of the original Neusa typeface serving both text and display purposes in print and on the web.

name: Qiber
classification_notes: A condensed, handmade display face mixing small caps into the lowercase for a playful, hand-set character rather than a conventional letterform structure.
summary: A condensed, handmade display face with a playful feel from mixing small caps into its lowercase.
description: Qiber gets its friendly, slightly off-kilter character from mixing small caps within its lowercase set, designed primarily for display use with a set of ornamental characters included.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Qiber as a condensed handmade font with a unique flavour and personality, friendly and playful thanks to mixing small caps within the lowercase character set.

name: Ruddy
classification_notes: A display sans with exaggerated geometry and varied vertical stem placement, built for an animated, mischievous headline presence rather than neutral text.
summary: A playful, mischievous display sans with exaggerated geometry and unevenly placed stems.
description: Ruddy leans into an animated, expressive character through exaggerated proportions and stems set at varied vertical positions, with italics and a variable release for headline and decorative use.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Ruddy as a display sans serif type family with a playful and mischievous presence, featuring exaggerated geometry and varied vertical character stem placement.

name: Rutan
classification_notes: A slightly condensed, geometrically founded modern sans built for pleasurable reading, favouring clarity and simplicity over display character.
summary: A slightly condensed, geometrically founded modern sans built for comfortable, everyday reading.
description: Rutan keeps its curves considered and its proportions compact, aiming squarely at branding, editorial and web use rather than display novelty. Alternate glyphs and manually edited kerning round out the family.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Rutan as a modern sans serif type family designed for pleasurable reading, skilfully shaped, slightly condensed and compact, with considered curves.

name: Seboff Display
classification_notes: A robust display serif built around decorative ink-trap detailing, giving it a tailored, formal character rather than a plain text-serif structure.
summary: A robust display serif that pushes its ink-trap detailing to the edge of ornament while staying legible.
description: Seboff Display treats ink traps as its main event, carving decorative notches into the letterforms for a modern, tailored look the foundry compares to a flamboyant, well-cut suit.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Seboff Display as a robust serif typeface conveying a modern and refined aesthetic, navigating the landscape of ink traps and pushing their ornamental intricacies while maintaining legibility.

name: Stölzl
classification_notes: A Bauhaus-inspired geometric sans named after Gunta Stölzl, split into a Display cut for headlines and an optically adjusted Text companion.
summary: A Bauhaus-inspired geometric sans named after Gunta Stölzl, the Bauhaus's sole female master.
description: Stölzl channels the Bauhaus's experimental idealism into a display cut built for contrast and headline presence, with an optically tailored Text companion and variable release for smaller sizes.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type say Stölzl is inspired by Bauhaus, capturing its original idealism and experiment-driven philosophy, named after Gunta Stölzl, the Bauhaus's sole female master.

name: Tabia
classification_notes: A geometric sans inspired by Dieter Rams' functionalist industrial design, with a technical, no-frills appearance across nine weights.
summary: A geometric sans inspired by Dieter Rams and Braun's functionalist industrial design.
description: Tabia carries a strong technical appearance drawn from Dieter Rams' work with Braun, backed by a wide nine-weight range and a set of alternate characters and ligatures.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Tabia as a geometric sans serif typeface inspired by the work and principles of Dieter Rams, closely associated with Braun and the Functionalist school of industrial design.

name: Tautz
classification_notes: A concept-driven humanist serif researched around British style and heritage, with a lowered x-height set against sharp, geometrically constructed serif details.
summary: A concept-driven humanist serif built from research into British style and heritage.
description: Tautz sets a lowered x-height against sharp, geometric serif details, creating deliberate tension on the page while staying versatile enough for both text and display use.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Tautz as a concept-driven serif font family, a contemporary take on the humanist serif with a touch of rationality and frivolity, researched around British style and heritage.

name: Tomarik
classification_notes: A pick-and-mix hand-drawn type collection spanning introvert, extrovert, poster, brush, display and serif variants rather than a single consistent letterform structure.
summary: A vibrant, hand-drawn type collection offering nine pick-and-mix display styles from brush to poster to serif.
description: Tomarik gathers nine hand-drawn variants under one name, from introvert and extrovert sans-style cuts to brush, poster, line and shadow treatments and a serif option, built as a flexible creative toolkit rather than a single voice.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Tomarik as a vibrant hand-drawn type collection, assembled with the pick-and-mix idea in mind, offering a great variety of flavour and zest.

name: Totokin
classification_notes: A moderately reverse-contrast slab serif, with horizontal strokes thicker than verticals, softened by curved, gentle letterforms.
summary: A moderately reverse-contrast slab serif with soft curves and a sturdy structure that still reads well at small sizes.
description: Totokin flips the usual stroke logic, giving horizontal strokes more weight than verticals, then rounds off the effect with gentle, welcoming curves suited to branding, editorial, packaging and signage work.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Totokin as a moderately reverse-contrast slab serif typeface, distinguished by a unique blend of soft curves, gentle forms and sturdy structure.

name: Uninsta
classification_notes: A low-contrast neutral sans combining geometric letterforms with humanist touches, positioned as a general-purpose text and display face.
summary: A neutral, low-contrast sans that pairs geometric letterforms with humanist touches across nine weights and full italics.
description: Uninsta is built as an all-purpose neutral sans, with alternate lowercase a and uppercase Q forms for a little personality against an otherwise even, legible base across digital and print use.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Uninsta as combining geometric letterforms with subtle humanist touches to create a legible, low-contrast typeface with great personality.

name: Vartek
classification_notes: A high-contrast, utilitarian geometric sans inspired by space-age and functionalist aesthetics, spanning Condensed to Expanded widths.
summary: A utilitarian, high-contrast geometric sans running from Condensed to Expanded, built with a space-age functionalist mood.
description: Vartek offers a full width system from Condensed to Expanded, keeping a high-contrast, utilitarian geometric structure throughout that nods to space-age design rather than corporate neutrality.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Vartek as a geometric sans-serif type family inspired by the space-age and functionalist aesthetics, a high-contrast utilitarian design with a variety of weight and width options.

name: Velik
classification_notes: A display face originating from hand-painted ink drawings, later digitised, giving it a naive, personable character across both display and text use.
summary: A fresh, naive display face that started life as hand-painted ink drawings before being digitised.
description: Velik keeps the loose, personable quality of its original ink drawings intact, working across both display and text applications with a vibrant, unpolished character.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Velik as fresh, naive, personable and vibrant, originating from hand-painted ink drawings that were subsequently digitised.

name: Webnar
classification_notes: A geometric sans built with information and technology contexts in mind, including alternate characters referencing Paul Renner's original Futura experiments.
summary: A geometric sans built with information and technology contexts in mind, with alternates that nod to Paul Renner's original Futura experiments.
description: Webnar prioritises functionality and legibility across print and digital use, softened at the edges with careful ink traps and offering a set of geometrically constructed alternates inspired by Renner's early Futura sketches.
foundry_blurb: Inhouse Type describe Webnar as a modern geometric sans serif font family created with information and technology in mind, featuring alternative characters inspired by Paul Renner's original experimental design for Futura.
